kind.description: Source for religious rulings, attributed teachings, exact quotations and calculated dates; Background for well-established biography, definitions and clearly fictional framing; Uncertainty for an honest limit or necessary clarification. Background and Uncertainty must have empty evidenceIds and quotations and null attribution.

text.description: One coherent explanatory paragraph. The first paragraph directly answers the current answerFocus. Source propositions must be supported by cited passages. Background must be well-established and must not introduce unsourced religious rulings or attributed teachings. Uncertainty must not smuggle in factual conclusions. Use ordinary Unicode punctuation, not control characters.

evidenceIds.description: For Source, existing evidence IDs that support the entire paragraph. Empty for Background and Uncertainty.

role.description: The exact part of this claim that the quotation supports, including how it addresses the current answerFocus when applicable.

text.description: One independently verifiable competing factual or interpretive proposition.

evidenceIds.description: Existing packet evidence IDs that together directly support the complete proposition.

role.description: The exact part of this disagreement that the quotation supports.

limitations.description: Specific evidence gaps only, including a missing requested rationale or authority when applicable.

clarifyingQuestion.description: Null unless clarification is needed or one tightly related continuation follows naturally.

humanGuidanceRecommended.description: False for ordinary explanatory, historical, textual, and source-identification questions.
